column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_field.prx (runtime base 0x090ced00, shared slot: registry ids carry the
# rel_field: prefix, addresses here do not); same columns as re/documented.tsv.

column3: summary

Switch: field map id 1-5 -> 0-4, 12-27 -> 5-20, 29-32 -> 21-24, 36-42 -> 25-31, anything else -> 0. No side effects. Callers: world_field_load_map, world_bind_map_archive, world_draw_sky_gradient, the resource loader 0x090e06c8 (kind 4) and 0x090e0a04.
Switch: field map id -> entry of field_strtbl_mapname.bin (resource 7) shown as the location name; 0 for ids it does not list. No side effects. Caller: world_show_location_name.

Handler of field request 3: params = {map id, exit-cell list, exit-cell count}. Sets the loading flag 0x09106be0 and the current map 0x09106bec, copies the 4-byte {s16 x, s16 y} exit cells into a new buffer 0x09106ffc (count 0x09107000), queues the map archive load (resource kind 4, completion world_bind_map_archive) and sets the light mode of the map for the current light period (world_set_light_mode, table rel_field +0x28a7c). Caller: field request table entry 3 (sent by rel_story world_send_exit_cells).
1 when (x, y) is in the exit-cell list stored by world_field_load_map, else 0. No side effects. Callers: world_field_read_command_input (field action 0), 0x090dc2a4 (NPC movement avoids exit cells).

Hard-coded door cells: on maps 12/37 nine cells -> maps 13, 14, 40, 40, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21; on map 36 cells (9, 0) and (10, 0) -> 39; else -1. No side effects. Caller: world_field_read_command_input (field action 17, acted on only for maps 12/37).

column2: int world_get_lab_special_cell(int map_id, int x, int y)
column3: Map 32 only: cells (32, 2)/(33, 2) -> 1, (30, 2)/(31, 2) -> 2, else 0. No side effects. Callers: world_field_read_command_input (1 -> action 9, 2 -> action 10), 0x090e34e0 (prompt text), 0x090def04.

column2: int world_is_cell_walkable(int x, int y, int mode)
column3: Walkability of cell (x, y): the hard-coded overrides return 0 first (mode 0: store cells (14, 17)/(14, 18), six classroom cells, the nine dorm door cells; mode 1 at light period 4: seven dorm door cells; any mode while the field event flag (context 0x091057f0 +0x14) is set: the classroom and dorm door cells); otherwise the walk-grid cell byte, 0 outside the grid. No side effects. Callers: world_clip_player_motion (mode 1), world_find_follower_cell (mode 0), 0x090dc2a4 NPC movement (mode 0).

column2: void world_sample_floor_height(float x, float z, float * position)
column3: Writes position[1], the floor height at grid-relative (x, z): picks cell (x / 0.5, z / 0.5) (on maps 12/37 the door cells (15, 24) and (15, 20/16/12) use the cell to their right), splits it on the v00-v11 diagonal (triangle v00, v01, v11 when position.x - v00.x < position.z - v00.z, else v00, v11, v10) and solves that triangle's plane for y. Leaves position unchanged outside the vertex array. VFPU vector helpers (BOOT 0x0881975c cross product, 0x0881972c dot product; identified from the plane formula, medium). Callers: 0x090d8d4c, 0x090d9bfc, 0x090dd7d8, 0x090df2ec, 0x090e21ec.

Per bound door object (0x09106c10, 0x60 bytes, count 0x09106fe0): opens it (state 1, sound via 0x090db820) when the player is within 0.75 units of the door position minus grid vertex 0 and closes it (state 3) beyond; doors stay shut while the field event flag is set (maps 2, 12, 37) and, on maps 12/37 at light period 4, those with targets 13-19 and 38; then animates kind 0 with world_animate_sliding_door and kind 1 with world_animate_hinged_door. Caller: 0x090d8c4c (field update).

column2: void world_island_area_of_map(int map_id, int * area, int * sub_point)
column3: Switch: map id -> island area 0-11 and, for area 4 (main building), sub-point 0-4 (maps 1-5); dorm rooms 13-21 and maps 37, 38 -> area 0; unlisted ids -> area 4 sub-point 0. Writes *area (and *sub_point for area 4 only). Callers: world_island_map_open, world_island_open_building_menu.
Inverse switch: area 0-11 -> map 12, 22, 23, 24, (1-5 by sub-point), 26, 25, 27, 29, 30, 31, 32; -1 otherwise. No side effects. Callers: world_island_map_step (result of the menu), 0x090e4dec.

Handler of field request 2: params = {current map, list of disabled map ids, count, unused, highlighted map}. Copies the 0x14-byte request, puts the cursor on the current map's area, builds the disabled-area mask 0x09899bd8 (bit = area; area 4 only when all five sub-points are disabled), loads the island archive of the light period (resource 2-6, world_<period>.ehp) and, unless the highlighted map is -1, places the partner-event marker at the area position (rel_field +0x298b0) + (-0x11, -0x28). Caller: field request table entry 2 (sent by rel_story world_open_island_map).

Clears the 0x340-byte portrait/talk-window state at 0x09105340 (busy flags and the three 0x100-byte slots at 0x09105370), then frees the slots' portraits (dialogue_free_portrait_slots). Side effects: that state. Callers: 2 (world_field_init_components, dialogue_reset_portraits).

Frees the talk-window portrait slots (dialogue_free_portrait_slots) and re-initialises the portrait state (dialogue_init_portraits). Side effects: those of the two callees. Callers: 1 (world_field_reset_components).

On GE layer 3 draws every active talk-window slot (+0xe4 set and a loaded portrait) except the top slot 0x09105678, then the top slot last: for each, the mouth layout +0x7c (params +0x80) when present and the portrait layout +0xc (params +0x10) with ui_ehf_begin_draw/draw/end_draw; commits the list pointer. Side effects: GE commands on layer 3. Callers: 1 (world_field_draw).

Start handler of field request 11: sets the busy word 0x09105340; for each of the params[1] portrait ids in the list params[0] increments the pending counter 0x09105670 and starts world_field_load_portrait(id, 1, world_field_portrait_loaded, 0, 0); clears the busy word when the count is below 1. Side effects: those writes and the portrait loads. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 11).
Poll handler of field request 11: returns true when the busy flag 0x09105340 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 11).

Start handler of field request 12 (release portraits): sets the busy flag 0x09105344 = 1, calls world_field_release_portrait_pool and dialogue_free_portrait_slots, then clears the busy flag; the request arguments are not read. Side effects: busy flag 0x09105344, the portrait pool and talk-window portrait slots freed. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 12).
Poll handler of field request 12: returns true when the busy flag 0x09105344 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 12).

Start handler of field request 13: args[0] points to args[1] entries {char, slot, value} (12 bytes). Sets busy 0x09105348 = 1, 0x09105360 = 0, count 0x09105674 = args[1]; for each entry: flag *(0x09105354 + slot x 4) = 1, frees the slot's portrait (dialogue_free_portrait_slot(0x09105370 + slot x 0x100)), stores char at slot +0xec, value at +0x70, slot at +0xf0, state +0xe8 = 1, sets the two sprite sub-blocks (+0x1c and +0x8c: flags |= 0x10004, RGB 0xff, alpha 0, x = float(table 0x090f36e0[slot])), then starts world_field_load_portrait(char, char != field context +0x18, world_field_portrait_loaded, slot base, 1). Side effects: talk-window slots 0x09105370 + slot x 0x100, asynchronous portrait loads. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 13).
Poll handler of field request 13: returns true when the busy flag 0x09105348 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 13).

Start handler of field request 14: args[0] points to args[1] pairs {slot, expression}; sets the busy flag 0x0910534c = 1, calls dialogue_set_portrait_expression(*(0x09105460 + s x 0x100), expression) for each slot s whose window is active (*(0x09105454 + s x 0x100) != 0), then clears the busy flag. Side effects: busy flag, those of dialogue_set_portrait_expression. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 14).
Poll handler of field request 14: returns true when the busy flag 0x0910534c is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 14).

Start handler of field request 15: args[0] points to an array of args[1] talk-window slot indices. Sets the busy flag 0x09105350 = 1; for each slot s whose window is active (*(0x09105454 + s x 0x100) != 0) sets the close flag *(0x09105364 + s x 4) = 1 and the window state *(0x09105458 + s x 0x100) = 3. The busy flag is not cleared here. Side effects: those globals. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 15).
Poll handler of field request 15: returns true when the busy flag 0x09105350 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 15).

For talk-window slot 0x09105370 + slot x 0x100: expression at +0x70, +0x74 = 0, +0x78 = system_rand_shifted() % 210 + 90; frame = dialogue_get_portrait_expression_frame(char +0xec, expression); sets the play range [frame + 4, frame + 15] and seeks frame + 4 on the portrait layout +0xc and, when present, on the second layout +0x7c (ui_ehf_set_play_range, ui_ehf_seek_frame). Side effects: the slot and its layout players. Callers: 2 (world_field_portrait_loaded, dialogue_field_req_set_portrait_expressions).

For talk-window slot slot (or all three when slot is 3) that is active (+0xe4): when the speaking word +0xe0 differs from speaking, stores it and seeks the mouth layout +0x7c (if any) to the expression's frame + 4 (dialogue_get_portrait_expression_frame). When speaking is non-zero, 0x09105678 = slot (1 when slot is 3), the slot drawn on top. Side effects: the slots, 0x09105678, layout frames. Callers: 2 (world_field_portrait_loaded, dialogue_update_portraits).

Calls dialogue_free_portrait_slot for the three talk-window slots 0x09105370 + i x 0x100 (i = 0..2). Side effects: those of dialogue_free_portrait_slot. Callers: 2 (dialogue_field_req_release_portraits, dialogue_init_portraits).

Frees one 0x100-byte talk-window portrait slot: when slot[0] is set clears the word *slot[2]; when slot[1] (the loaded data) is set frees it from the field heap (world_field_heap_free) and clears it; then clears the whole slot. Side effects: the slot, a heap free. Callers: 3 (dialogue_field_req_show_portraits, dialogue_update_portraits, dialogue_free_portrait_slots).

Gets the character's key pair with world_get_character_key(character, &k1, &k2), finds the entry world_find_triple_key_entry(k1, k2, expression) and returns its word +0xc, or 0 when there is none. No side effects. Callers: 3 (dialogue_set_portrait_expression, dialogue_set_portrait_speaking, dialogue_update_portraits).
Clears the 0x1c-byte field context block 0x091057f0. Side effects: writes 0x091057f0-0x0910580b. Callers: 1 (world_field_init_module).

Returns the address of the field context block 0x091057f0. No side effects. Callers: 24 (world_open_event_command_bar, world_field_command_step, world_update_character_walk_frame, ui_field_hud_draw_partner_panel, ...).
Returns thunk_system_strstr(name, ".") + 1 (the string \".\" at 0x090fc148), the part of name after the first dot (1 when there is no dot). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_bind_map_archive).

Clears the word 0x09105930 and the overhead icon pool 0x09105b10 (world_clear_overhead_icon_pool). Side effects: writes 0x09105930 and the pool. Callers: 2 (world_field_init_components, world_reset_overhead_icons).
Resets the overhead icons: world_free_overhead_icons then world_init_overhead_icons. Side effects: those of the callees (overhead icon pool 0x09105b10). Callers: 1 (world_field_reset_components).
Clears words +0x04 and +0x08 of a field character object. Side effects: writes those words. Callers: 3 (world_free_npcs, world_free_partner, world_free_player).
Copies the position words +0x10, +0x14, +0x18 of a field object into out with system_copy_vec3. Side effects: writes out[0..2]. Callers: 1 (world_get_player_position).

Start handler of field request 5: sets the busy word 0x09105930, releases the character resource pools with world_field_release_character_pools and clears the busy word. Side effects: those of world_field_release_character_pools. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 5).
Poll handler of field request 5: returns 1 when the busy word 0x09105930 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 5 poll).

Clears the 0x154-byte field-side talk state at 0x09105934 (talk-line and choice-menu busy flags, states and list-window descriptor area). Side effects: 0x09105934..0x09105a87. Callers: 2 (dialogue_reset_talk, world_field_init_components).

Calls the no-op dialogue_stub_noop_talk_release, then clears the field talk state 0x09105934 (dialogue_clear_talk_state). Side effects: 0x09105934..0x09105a87 cleared. Callers: 1 (world_field_reset_components).
Empty function (no-op) in the talk-window release path. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_field_shutdown_components, dialogue_reset_talk).

Per-frame talk update. State 2 (choice): updates the list window 0x09105950; on a result resets it, clears busy 0x09105938 and the state and stores the answer in 0x09105a84. State 1 (talk line): when the line is finished (ui_field_get_message_window_db4) either ends the request (busy 0x09105934 = 0) or, with the close flag 0x09105940, closes the message window and waits for its animation (0x09105944); otherwise slides the window (dialogue_update_talk_window_hide). In both states field context +8 = 0x09105948 while the message prints, else -1. Side effects: those globals, the message window. Callers: 1 (world_field_update).

Selects GE layer 3 (system_ge_select_layer(3, 0)); talk state 0x0910593c = 2 draws the choice menu (dialogue_draw_choice_menu), 1 calls the pass-through dialogue_stub_return_arg_talk_draw; then commits the list pointer (system_ge_commit_layer_pointer). Side effects: GE commands on layer 3. Callers: 1 (world_field_draw).

Start handler of field request 17 (narration/talk line), args = {text, speaker, word}. Sets busy 0x09105934 = 1; if the message window is not shown and text is NULL it clears busy and does nothing more; otherwise clears 16 bytes at 0x09105940, stores args[2] at 0x09105948, sets wait-for-input (ui_field_set_message_wait_input(1)), window descriptor +0x44 = 4 and +0x48 = 2, and either sets the close flag 0x09105940 = 1 (NULL text) or calls ui_field_set_message_text(text, speaker), sets 0x0910594c = 1.0f and field context +8 = args[2]; then state 0x0910593c = 1. Always toggles descriptor +0x74 (0 <-> 1). Side effects: those globals and the message window. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 17).
Poll handler of field request 17: returns true when the busy flag 0x09105934 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 17).

Start handler of field request 18: copies args[1] option text pointers from args[0] to 0x09105a70, measures them (dialogue_measure_choice_width), clears and fills the list-window descriptor 0x09105950 (0x120 bytes: item count args[1] at 0x09105a1c, width + 0x23 at 0x09105a40, item sizes 0x19/0x17 when save_get_language() is 0 else 0x13/0x11, draw callback dialogue_draw_choice_item at 0x09105a4c, heap world_field_get_heap(), flags), opens it with ui_open_list_window, centres it (0x091059a8 = 240 - *0x091059bc x 0.5), toggles the message-window descriptor +0x74 and sets state 0x0910593c = 2. Side effects: busy flag 0x09105938 = 1, those globals, an open list window. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 18).

Poll handler of field request 18: stores the menu answer word 0x09105a84 in *out_answer and returns true when the busy flag 0x09105938 is 0. Side effects: *out_answer. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, entry 18).
Returns its argument unchanged. No side effects. Callers: 1 (dialogue_draw_talk).

Draws a full-screen fill with colour 0x80000000 (ui_draw_screen_fill(list, 0, 0x80000000)) and then the choice-menu list window 0x09105950 (ui_draw_list_window); returns the advanced GE list. Side effects: GE commands written. Callers: 1 (dialogue_draw_talk).

column2: void dialogue_draw_choice_item(void *list, ushort index, int x, int y)
column3: List-window item callback of the choice menu: builds "<'1' + index><string 0x090f392c><option text 0x09105a70[index]>", enables ruby when save_get_language() is 0, begins an external font list on list, scale 15, shadow, colour codes, colour 0xff000000, draws the text at (x + 4, y + 1) to the screen edge and ends the font list. Side effects: GE commands written, font state. No direct caller (callback stored at 0x09105a4c by dialogue_field_req_choice_menu).

Saves the font shadow and ruby settings, sets scale 15 x 15, shadow and ruby on, returns the widest option in pixels (max of system_font_measure_string(options[i]) >> 6 over count options) and restores both settings. Side effects: none lasting (font settings restored). Callers: 1 (dialogue_field_req_choice_menu).

Slides the field message window: while pad button bit 0x100 is held the factor 0x0910594c decreases by c + c x f (c = float 0x090f3934, min 0), otherwise it grows the same way up to 1; the window position (ui_field_get_message_window_pos) is lerped between the points 0x090fc17c/80 and 0x090fc184/88 by it; ui_field_set_message_window_dcc(0) when fully shown, else 1. Side effects: 0x0910594c, the window position and flag. Callers: 1 (dialogue_update_talk).
Clears the 0x18-byte field picture state 0x09105a88 with memset. Side effects: writes 0x09105a88-0x09105a9f. Callers: 2 (ui_field_reset_picture, world_field_init_components).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_field_shutdown_components, ui_field_reset_picture).
Poll handler of a field request: returns true when the picture state word 0x09105a88 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table).
Clears the 0x14-byte day banner state 0x09105aa0 with memset. Side effects: writes 0x09105aa0-0x09105ab3. Callers: 2 (ui_field_reset_day_banner, world_field_init_components).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_field_shutdown_components, ui_field_reset_day_banner).
Returns true when the day banner state word 0x09105aa0 is 0. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_field_update_busy_flags).
Stores value in the word 0x09105b00 used by the object draw list. Side effects: writes 0x09105b00. Callers: 1 (world_draw_object_list).
Clears the 0xc00-byte overhead icon pool 0x09105b10. Side effects: writes 0x09105b10-0x0910670f. Callers: 1 (world_init_overhead_icons).
Clears the 0xc00-byte overhead icon pool 0x09105b10. Side effects: writes 0x09105b10-0x0910670f. No direct caller.
Clears the 0x60-byte overhead icon block icon with thunk_system_memset. Side effects: writes icon[0..0x5f]. Callers: 1 (world_set_player_overhead_icon).
Returns word +0x58 of a field character object (its overhead icon kind). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_update_player).
Clears the 0x80-byte camera-shake state 0x09106710. Side effects: writes 0x09106710-0x0910678f. Callers: 1 (world_field_init_components).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_field_reset_components).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_field_shutdown_components).

Reads the pad state with thunk_system_pad_get_state and runs world_update_camera_shake for this frame. Side effects: those of world_update_camera_shake (camera offsets). Callers: 1 (world_field_update).
Stores mode in the field light-mode word 0x0910678c (light mode per map and period, world.md). Side effects: writes 0x0910678c. Callers: 1 (world_field_load_map).

Start handler of field request 20: sets the camera-shake active word 0x09106710, clears the 0x20-byte shake state 0x09106720, then 0x09106720 = (params[0] == 0), 0x09106724 = params[1], 0x0910672c = params[0]. Side effects: writes 0x09106710 and 0x09106720-0x0910673f. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 20).
Poll handler of field request 20: returns 1 when the camera-shake active word 0x09106710 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 20 poll).

Start handler of field request 21: clears the camera-shake active word 0x09106710 and the word 0x09106714. Side effects: writes 0x09106710 and 0x09106714. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 21).
Poll handler of field request 21: returns 1 when the word 0x09106714 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 21 poll).
Clears the 0x1a0-byte reward display state 0x09106790 (card/item get record) with memset. Side effects: writes 0x09106790-0x0910692f. Callers: 1 (world_init_command_state).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_free).
Sets the HUD date panel state 0x09106a28 to 1 (start). Side effects: writes 0x09106a28. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_open).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_free).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_free).
Starts the HUD time icon: 0x09106ad0 = 0, state 0x09106ac0 = 1. Side effects: writes 0x09106ac0 and 0x09106ad0. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_open).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_free).
Sets the HUD partner panel state 0x09106ad4 to 1 (start). Side effects: writes 0x09106ad4. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_open).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_free).
Sets the HUD points meter state 0x09106ae4 to 1 (start). Side effects: writes 0x09106ae4. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_open).
Empty function: returns immediately. No side effects. Callers: 1 (ui_field_hud_free).

Sets 0x09106bb4 = 1; when request is still active (word 0x090fcc14 + request x 12) polls it with world_field_poll and returns 0 if it is not finished; otherwise calls the request's start handler (word 0 of the entry at 0x090fcc0c + request x 12) with params, marks it active and returns 1. Side effects: 0x09106bb4, the active word, those of the start handler. Callers: 1 (world_field_debug_run_requests); exported, called from rel_story (38).

Calls the poll handler of request (word 1 of the 12-byte entry at 0x090fcc0c + request x 12) with out; when it returns non-zero clears the entry's active word (0x090fcc14 + request x 12). Returns 1 when the request is finished. Side effects: those of the poll handler; clears the active word. Callers: 3 (world_field_request, world_field_debug_run_requests, world_field_command_step); exported, called from rel_story (36).

Start handler of field request 1: sets the busy word 0x09106b90, stores params[0] (the event flag) at field context +0x14 (world_get_field_context), opens the event command bar (world_open_event_command_bar), clears 0x09106bbc and the busy word. Side effects: field context +0x14, 0x09106bbc, those of world_open_event_command_bar. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 1).
Poll handler of field request 1: returns 1 when the busy word 0x09106b90 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 1 poll).

Start handler of field request 2: sets 0x09106b94 = 1, opens the island map with world_island_map_open(params) and sets 0x09106bbc = 1. Side effects: those of world_island_map_open; writes 0x09106b94 and 0x09106bbc. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 2).
Poll handler of field request 2: returns 1 when the word 0x09106b94 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 2 poll).

Start handler of field request 31: sets the busy word 0x09106b98; when params[0] is non-zero starts the day banner (ui_field_start_day_banner); opens the HUD (ui_field_hud_open with 1 when 0x09106bbc is 1, 0 when it is 0) and the DP display; sets field context +0x0c and +0x10 to 1; when 0x09106bbc is 0 plays the map ambient sounds. Side effects: those writes and the UI and sound callees. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 31).
Poll handler of field request 31: returns 1 when the busy word 0x09106b98 is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 31 poll).

Start handler of field request 32: sets the busy word 0x09106b9c, releases and re-initialises the DP display (500, 0x67, 0x16c, 0x67) and the message window (field heap, 0x27, 400, 0xe, 1, 3), resets the field components, clears 0x09106bb4 and field context +0x0c/+0x10, and when 0x09106bbc is 0 stops the sound effects with audio_field_stop_se_500ms. Side effects: those writes and callees. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 32).
Poll handler of field request 32: returns 1 when the busy word 0x09106b9c is 0. No side effects. No direct caller (field request table rel_field +0x2df0c, request 32 poll).
